summary: Enhance your ability to support others in emergencies with our Psychological First Aid course. Be prepared to respond effectively in crisis situations.
lede: Psychological first aid training prepares crisis responders to offer practical, non-clinical support to people experiencing distress. Designed for professionals with crisis-response, safeguarding, health, humanitarian, security, or workforce-care responsibilities, it covers how to notice safety concerns, listen without pressuring people to disclose, and identify immediate practical needs. Participants also practice connecting people with appropriate services and escalating safeguarding or clinical concerns through referral pathways.
audienceIntro: This psychological first aid training is designed for professionals who already carry crisis-response, safeguarding, health, humanitarian, security, or workforce-care responsibilities and need a structured operational approach.
audience: Mental Health and Psychosocial Support Officer
Security and Duty of Care Manager
prerequisites: You should bring working knowledge of your organization’s crisis-response or safeguarding procedures and, where appropriate, a sanitized example of a referral directory or incident-support workflow. No coding or programming is required. A laptop with spreadsheet access and a modern web browser supports the digital exercises. Advanced safeguarding, mental health referral, remote support, and digital information topics are taught at operational application level. The WHO mhGAP Humanitarian Intervention Guide receives conceptual coverage so you can identify referral triggers without performing clinical diagnosis.
